description: Returns the user's most recently updated Palim thread as a handoff: state, decisions and open items. Useful at the start of a new chat; the thread may be unrelated to the current request. Project filter is case-insensitive.

include_messages.description: Optional: append the tail of the transcript when the thread has stored messages. Default false.

project.description: Optional: only consider threads belonging to this project (case-insensitive; Logisoft ≡ logisoft).

tool_source.description: Optional: only consider threads from one client (cursor, claude, codex, chatgpt, ...).

within_hours.description: Optional: ignore threads older than this many hours. Omit to always return the latest thread.

name: palim_resume
